title: Create project-local rollback manifest and backup of files/packages this run will change; verify backup hashes and restoration procedure; record ownership boundary

environment.note: The real UE project (.uproject/.umap/.uasset/C++) and the Unreal Connector (uehl) live on the host (Windows E:\) only. They are reachable via the Connector, which is a Windows app not installed on this Pi session. No host-side editor save workflow can be exercised from Pi; the project is therefore absent on this mount.

task.objective: Create a project-local rollback manifest and backup only of the files/packages this run will change, using the documented editor save workflow, preserving previous backups; verify backup hashes and the restoration procedure without restoring over active content; record the ownership boundary.
task.doc_save_workflow_status: not_available_on_pi (Unreal Connector / UE editor save workflow is host-side only and unavailable here)
task.local_equivalent: Project-local rollback manifest + content-addressed backup copies of the managed project-local files, with hash verification. This is the project-local stand-in for the host-side editor save/backup workflow, applicable to the files this step actually manages.

managed_scope.project_or_package_files_changed: none — no .uproject/.umap/.uasset/C++ files on the Pi mount, so no project-local actor/package IDs exist to backup here

backup.preserve_note: first baseline; each run uses a distinct dated/named subdir so earlier backups are never overwritten or restored over
backup.restore_procedure: Recovery restores backup_root/<rel> to <root>/<rel> only after the failing change is removed and the restore is explicitly approved. Integrity is confirmed by re-hashing the backup copy and comparing to the manifest sha256. This run verified all 13 backup copies match source and manifest; no copy-back occurred, so no active content was overwritten.

ownership_boundary.writable_owner_project: /workspace/Unreal Projects/NebulaSwamp (9p rw bind of Windows E:\)
ownership_boundary.excluded: host-side UE project files and the 3D Resource Kit source mount are not part of this project-local backup (kit is read-only; UE project is host-side only and absent on the Pi mount)
